entities.name: Tibor Cselkó
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tibor Cselkó was a Hungarian basketball player who competed in the 1952 Summer Olympics. He was born in Budapest. He was part of the Hungarian basketball team, which was eliminated after the group stage of the 1952 tournament. He played all six matches.
